description: Federal Protection for Family and Medical Leave
whatThisIs: This is a federal law providing qualifying employees 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per year. Two things need to happen for you to qualify, first if you have completed at least one of the following: Have been employed with the company for at least 12 months, or worked  at least 1,250 hours over the last 12 month period. Second, the location of the company at which you work employs 50 or more employees within 75 miles. This usually can come into play for chain locations, as most stores do not employ 50 people however their surrounding areas stores can when combined.

whoItHelps: People and Families living in states that don’t have paid family and medical state programs
whatToKnow: To be clear Massachusetts has its own state laws for paid family leave, if you are looking for paid family/medical leave please visit the profile titled “PFML (Paid Family and Medical Leave)

FMLA applies for people who need to take time off: for the birth of a child, the placement of child in the case of adoptions, to take care of a family member due to a serious medical condition, and to take medical leave for the employee for a serious medical condition

As this is federal law not state or federal program there is no ‘application’ process, so far as you are eligible you can request the time off directly from your employer. Depending on the reason your employer can request certification from a health care provider, however you do not have to disclose your health condition, look at the Employe Rights pamphlet for my discussion and information about how application and certification request work
